_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mushandisi {player_id}, uchida kudzana {num_rounds} maitiro ya Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Wana {pool} kudzora maitiro aya kati yenyu na Mushandisi {other_id}.

Mubatsiri:
  - Tengesa chidhiuro: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= chikwata)
  - Ichi chetewo → Unopota $(chikwata - X), mushandisi wechiperi unopota $X
  - Ichingapiwa → Vose vanopota $0
  - Kufanana: [Offer: $3]  kana  'Ndingoti ndiyo yakanaka. [Offer: $5]'

Mushandisi wechiperi:
  - Uvere chidhiuro nenhau [Accept] kana [Reject]
  - Kufanana: 'Kana kwenyu kwauri. [Accept]'
            'Kuva kudhara. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Maitiro {round_number} yanovatenga! ---
Mushandisi {proposer_id} ndiye mubatsiri, Mushandisi {responder_id} ndiye mushandisi wechiperi.
round.accepted: Mushandisi {responder_id} wakachema! Maitiro {round_number} anotenga: Mushandisi {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Mushandisi {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Makumi mapya: Mushandisi 0: ${total_0}, Mushandisi 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Player {responder_id} rejected the offer! Round {round_number} gains: Both players +$0. Totals remain: Player 0: ${total_0}, Player 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Anopa chikumbiro anofanira kuita chipo achishandisa fomati [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: Mari yechibvumirano inofanira kuva nhamba yakakwana.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Chipo chinofanira kuva pakati pe $0 ne${pool}.

outcome.win: Mushandisi {winner} akatsora nemakumi {winner_total} wotonga kubva kwaMushandisi {loser} nemakumi {loser_total}.
